assign.request: The live page is only a narrow column... the text is way too wide... Take a screenshot at 3440 and you'll see that 50% of the page is just empty space... I think we want to rely on columns more. I don't know how many columns deep we want to go.
assign.now: before shots at four widths, coordinating with ai2-dashboard
builder on round 2: default-open agent column, takeover instead of push-down

decision.msg: Columns switch on the card's own width (container query: 1 below 60em, 2 at 60em, 3 at 95em with the agent column, 4 at 130em with the chat as its own column). The columns have different lengths; nothing stretches. Alternatives rejected: masonry (boxes reshuffle whenever live data changes), equal-height rows (about 1000px of blank box under usage), one centred column (half a 3440 screen empty).
Every line of reading text is capped at the measure (about 37em), the chat included. The alternative, a full-width chat, is what the owner complained about.

From 95em up, the agent column starts filled with assistant-fast (sticky, changes only on a click), so no empty hint box and nothing moves when you open one. Below 95em the conversation takes over the card body with a back link, never pushing the list down (the owner, 09-22, relayed by ai2-dashboard). Alternative: in place under the row, as the brief said; rejected because the owner has already called push-down the wrong experience.

log.msg: coordinated: ai2-dashboard owns the rail head (.ai2-chrome) and overview.js only; core-columns changes the Page column clamp, which the Live card does not read; md-pages changed the .pages:has(> .page--ai2) guard, which must be kept at merge

assign.outcome:
**The Live card fills wide screens in columns, and no line of text is wider than a reading width** — merged into michael/dev (branch worktree/live-card-wide, eca9ceb7).

- [Live card](/framework/ai2/live/): 1 column below 60em, 2 at 60em, 3 at 95em (the agent's conversation beside the list), 4 at 130em (the chat gets its own column). The widest line of text is now about 600px at every width (it was 2622px at 3440).
- Empty area at 3440 went from 0.76 to 0.27, and at 2560 from 0.65 to 0.10.
- From 95em up, the agent column opens with assistant-fast already in it and changes only when you click. Narrower than that, a clicked agent takes over the card, with a back link; nothing is pushed down.
- The rule for how many navigation levels fit at each width, with screenshots: [ai2/doc/columns.md](/framework/ai2/doc/columns/).
